items.name: MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft_X_some
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (x : S₁),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) (MvPolynomial.X (some x)) = Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X x)

items.name: MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft_coeff_some_coeff_none
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : Option S₁ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),
  MvPolynomial.coeff n.some (((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) f).coeff (n none)) = MvPolynomial.coeff n f

items.name: MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft_coeff_coeff
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R) (m : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff d (((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) p).coeff m) = MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.optionElim m d) p

items.name: MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft
items.type: (R : Type u) → (S₁ : Type v) → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial (MvPolynomial S₁ R)

items.name: MvPolynomial.natDegree_optionEquivLeft
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R),
  ((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) p).natDegree = MvPolynomial.degreeOf none p
